travel_dk.h: Hygge is a Norwegian word as much as a Danish one, and in a 2011 study of Danish middle-class families the anthropologist Jeppe Trolle Linnet found that hygge also works as a vehicle of social control, with its own hierarchy of attitudes

travel_dk.h: Iceland’s Blue Lagoon is the runoff pond of the Svartsengi geothermal plant, which began dumping hot brine on a lava field in 1976 expecting it to drain away, and the silica in the cooling water sealed the porous rock instead, caulking the basin of the country’s most visited attraction
travel_dk.y: Nobody designed the Blue Lagoon. That is the detail the spa’s serene marketing photographs, all steam and milky turquoise against black rock, politely decline to mention.
